title: AR-WAM: efficient streaming world-action modeling for autonomous driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.21851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous driving requires anticipating how traffic will evolve while responding quickly to new observations. Video foundation models offer the first ability, but repeated history encoding and iterative video generation make them costly to use for driving. We present AR-WAM, an efficient streaming world-action model that combines autoregressive temporal modeling with single-pass future conditioning. Because its video backbone is causal, AR-WAM updates its visual context incrementally, reusing past computation and conditioning future prediction on observed motion. We further hypothesize that future features computed from recent observations can improve generalization in dynamic traffic without iterative video generation. AR-WAM therefore obtains these features in one forward pass and uses them to condition trajectory generation, and reinforcement learning then improves the policy through direct optimization of driving rewards. translated_title: AR-WAM：面向自动驾驶的高效流式世界-动作建模
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶需要在快速响应新观测的同时预测交通状况的演变。视频基础模型提供了第一种能力，但重复的历史编码和迭代的视频生成使其在驾驶应用中成本高昂。我们提出了AR-WAM，这是一种高效的流式世界-动作模型，它将自回归时序建模与单次前向传递的未来条件化相结合。由于其视频骨干网络是因果的，AR-WAM能够增量式地更新其视觉上下文，复用过去的计算，并将未来预测条件化于观测到的运动。我们进一步假设，从近期观测计算得到的未来特征可以在无需迭代视频生成的情况下提升动态交通场景中的泛化能力。因此，AR-WAM通过单次前向传递获得这些特征，并利用它们对轨迹生成进行条件化，随后通过直接优化驾驶奖励的强化学习来改进策略。
tldr: AR-WAM是一种高效的流式世界-动作模型，通过因果自回归建模增量更新视觉上下文、单次前向传递获取未来特征以条件化轨迹生成，并利用强化学习直接优化驾驶奖励，从而低成本地实现自动驾驶中的交通预测与轨迹规划。
en_tdlr: AR-WAM is an efficient streaming world-action model that incrementally updates visual context via causal autoregressive modeling, conditions trajectory generation on single-pass future features, and uses reinforcement learning to directly optimize driving rewards for low-cost autonomous driving prediction and planning.
